email.subject: Quick fix for Breakwater Works' site
email.body:
Hi Grace,

I looked at Breakwater Works Fitness's site. Two things are likely costing you members: there's no click-to-call link, so anyone checking your site on their phone has to manually type your number instead of tapping to call. And the footer still shows old info (hours, maybe a past promo), which makes people second-guess whether you're still open before they bother reaching out.

Both are quick fixes. I'd like to offer a free 10-minute walkthrough showing exactly what I'd change and why, no obligation.

Free Tuesday or Wednesday afternoon?

Alex
Northlight Web
